note: Generated by scripts/generate-native-surface.mjs from capacitor.config.ts, android/variables.gradle, android/app/build.gradle and AndroidManifest.xml. Do not edit by hand. The permission NAMES are owned by scripts/check-support-claims.mjs, which guards them against the /supported screen in both directions; only the count appears here.

platforms.android: supported - builds automatically, proven to work by hand
platforms.ios: the PWA only. The native project was dropped 2026-09-20 (869f13c92); see docs/ios-platform-footprint.md

distribution.what: release-android.yml builds a signed APK and attaches it to a GitHub Release
distribution.consequence: not a store, so the app updates itself through apk-updater.plugin.ts, which is why REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES is requested at all
